summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the repository without running tests or repository code, and without committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges before width and now yields one Text object with click spans appended last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved; the layout resolver Edge already had size, min_size, and fraction defaults, so it was left unchanged. Added docs/reference/widgets/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, four new UnderlineBar tests appended to tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with __init__.py. Judgment calls: bar position indexes the full tab list and maps to displayed label ranges, so duplicate names place the underline correctly; letter search only applies to single-character keys; a zero-width label can shift later cells because it becomes a flexible edge. Nothing has been executed, so the test suite is unverified.
